title: Smash: Hitch Under, Corner Over
coaching_points: The hitch settles short and stays in front of the cornerback.
The corner route runs over the top of that same cornerback.
Read the cornerback: if he sits on the hitch, throw the corner.

lines.text: One cornerback. Two routes. He can't cover both.
Smash puts a hitch under and a corner over the top.
First: the hitch settles short, right in front of him.
Second: the corner runs over the top of the same defender.
Third: read the cornerback and throw away from his choice.
High-low on one defender, every single snap.
Smash, in Grid Iron Vault.

caption: Smash: hitch under, corner over the top. One cornerback, two routes, one right throw. Draw it, teach it, run it. Build your playbook in Grid Iron Vault.
review_flags: Which coverage Smash beats is not in the CSV row, so the script makes no coverage claim.

title: Flood Right: Read It High to Low
coaching_points: Three receivers run to the right at three depths: flat, out, corner.
Read the three routes from the deepest down to the shortest.
Throw to the receiver the defense has left uncovered.

lines.text: Three receivers. One side. Not enough defenders.
Flood Right sends three players to one side at three depths.
First: flat, out and corner stack up at three levels.
Second: read the routes high to low, starting deep.
Third: throw to whoever the defense left uncovered.
Three levels beat two defenders. Simple math.
Flood Right, in Grid Iron Vault.

caption: Flood Right: flat, out and corner on one side. Read it high to low and throw to the open receiver. Teach your team the read. Build your playbook in Grid Iron Vault.
review_flags: Row says three levels outnumber the two defenders who can cover that side; the script uses that sentence as given and names no coverage.

title: Mesh: Two Drags, One Open Man
coaching_points: Two receivers run drags that cross each other at four yards.
The crossing receivers run defenders into each other.
Throw to whichever receiver comes free.

lines.text: Two receivers cross. Defenders collide. Someone comes free.
That's Mesh: two drags crossing at four yards.
First: both receivers run drags and cross each other.
Second: crossing routes run defenders into each other.
Third: throw to whoever comes free.
Somebody comes free every single time.
Mesh, in Grid Iron Vault.

caption: Mesh: two drags crossing at four yards. Defenders run into each other and somebody comes free. See it from above, then draw it in Grid Iron Vault.
